caption: The drawing depicts two main objects. On the left, there is an arched plaque with a thick red border and a pale yellow-beige background. Inside the plaque, there is a large grey bird, likely a dove, with wings outstretched; the bird is outlined in black and has stylized rays in red and orange emanating from behind it. Below the bird, there are sequences of small colored circles, and the letters "A" and "R" are placed on either side of the bird's tail. The second object is a horizontal balustrade situated across the lower section of the composition, featuring a row of short, turned balusters in alternating light grey and red colors. The balustrade has a rectangular top and bottom rail, both with red borders, and the shape of the balusters varies, with some featuring red geometric shapes and others grey with spiral forms. The background is a uniform light beige.
title: Lunette from Altar-Church at Llano Quemado Altar Rail-Church at Sanctuario, Chimayo
